title: Gluten-Free British Sausage Roll
description: A classic British snack adapted to be gluten-free, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: lovely british sausage
ingredients.notes: make sure to check the ingredients for gluten-free status

ingredients.name: gluten-free roll
ingredients.notes: look for a pre-made gluten-free roll or make your own

instructions: Wrap each sausage in the gluten-free roll.
Place the sausage rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the sausage is cooked through and the roll is golden brown.
